cases.title: Software invention branching

inputs.title: Distributed Transaction Ordering Protocol
inputs.problem: A software system needs deterministic transaction ordering without a single leader becoming a bottleneck.
inputs.solution: Nodes exchange threshold signatures over peer-to-peer channels and commit transactions in DAG order.
inputs.components: Gossip communication module, DAG ledger buffer, threshold signature verifier, and state committer.

cases.title: AI invention branching without fabricating training data

inputs.title: Dynamic Sparse Attention Neural Network
inputs.problem: Dense attention over high-frequency sensor streams consumes excessive memory and computation.
inputs.solution: A routing neural network trained by model training assigns sensor tokens to top matching latent clusters before sparse attention inference.
inputs.components: Input encoder, routing neural network, sparse cross-attention transformer layers, and linear projection head.

cases.title: Mechanical invention branching without inventing measurements

inputs.title: Adaptive Compliant Gripper Assembly
inputs.problem: Rigid robotic grippers overload motors when grasping irregular mechanical workpieces.
inputs.solution: Tendon-driven fingers move through differential gearing with torsional spring compliance.
inputs.components: Mounting flange, planetary differential gear train, three articulated finger segments, and elastomer grip pads.

cases.title: Chemical invention flags specialist review

inputs.title: Catalyst Composition
inputs.problem: Polymer synthesis requires high temperatures that degrade yield.
inputs.solution: A catalyst composition with supported concentration ranges lowers reaction temperature.
inputs.components: Catalyst compound, polymer precursor, and solvent system.

cases.title: Biotech invention flags specialist review

inputs.title: Antibody Assay
inputs.problem: Cell-surface markers are difficult to detect reliably in assay workflows.
inputs.solution: An antibody reagent binds the marker and produces an observable assay signal.
inputs.components: Antibody reagent, cell sample preparation, and assay readout.
